newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100, down near day's low on Halifax debut.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100, down near day's low on Halifax debut.

text.p: The UK FTSE 100 share index was moderately lower in late morning trading on Monday, tracking a volatile bank sector in the wake of the Halifax Plc market debut.
The newly floated shares, which began trading at 774-1/2p, saw bank shares initially race ahead, only to crack on profit-taking within the first 30 minutes of the trading session.
Losses in the sector spilled over, and at 1017 GMT, the FTSE 100 was down 20.6 points to 4,600.7, having earlier dipped below technical support at 4,600.
